blocks.text: Seller net proceeds calculator: estimate what you would walk away with

faq.q: What does the home evaluation on this page actually produce?
faq.a: A Comparative Market Analysis (CMA): Jared evaluates the prices of properties similar to yours that have recently sold in your area, giving you a better idea of your property's market value as a first step in preparing to sell.

faq.q: How do I request one, and what happens next?
faq.a: Complete and submit the form on the page — the page says it takes a few quick minutes — and Jared contacts you as soon as he has the results; the form's visible selector asks for the home's size in bands from 500 sq. ft. to 4,000+ sq. ft.

faq.q: Which areas does Jared cover for home evaluations?
faq.a: The seven areas the page lists: South Surrey, White Rock, Langley, Abbotsford, Surrey, Tsawwassen and Ladner; the page invites anyone unsure their home is in one of them to call or text 604-928-1361.

faq.q: Does requesting an evaluation make me Jared's client?
faq.a: The page does not say. Under the BC framework BCFSA publishes, a licensee must disclose at the outset of dealings whether they can represent you as a client and what duties are owed to clients and non-clients — ask for that disclosure when the evaluation conversation starts.
